description: Layer 1 trigger pack for deep multi-perspective review across security, correctness, and architecture.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Do a deep pre-release review of this branch with security, correctness, and architecture lenses.
I want the heavy-duty code review, not the quick pass.
Run a multi-perspective review on this risky payment rewrite.
Deep review this release candidate and consolidate findings.
Give me the three-angle review for this auth overhaul.
Full code audit on this branch before production.
Do the parallel deep review on these changes.
This is security-critical; use the deep review workflow.
I need a deeper code review with confidence gating.
Thorough branch review across security, correctness, and architecture.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Audit our upgrade funnel end to end: competitor patterns, product gaps, UX friction, and a roadmap for what to build next.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /feature-audit: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Be brutally honest about this startup idea, and if it survives scaffold the project plan and CLAUDE.md for me.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /idea-audit: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Review this diff for runtime bugs, security issues, and broken logic. Keep false positives low.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /quick-review: Fast code review of a diff or PR.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Find the real bug in this flaky payment flow, prove the root cause, fix it, and add a regression test.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /deep-fix: Root-cause-first debugging and verified fix request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Generate unit tests for src/orders.js and follow the repo's Vitest style.
Analyze this branch diff and give me a deploy checklist: env vars, migrations, new workers, and breaking changes.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /release-check: Deploy or ship-readiness checklist request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Create a draft PR for this branch with a concise title, summary, and affected areas.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /create-pr: Explicit request to open or draft a PR or MR.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Scout the best external skills for this repo and explain which ones we should import first.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /skill-scout: Scout external skill catalogs for relevant imports.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Give me a v0.dev prompt for redesigning the analytics dashboard.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /v0-design: Explicit request for a v0.dev design prompt.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Turn this imported skill into Arcana quality: rewrite the frontmatter, structure, and missing sections.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /import-skill: Adapt an imported skill to Arcana quality standards.
